title: Resurrecting Atlantis

location.name: Atlantis, the Radiant City (from the Light Gates to the Narrow Streets)
location.kind: walled cyberpunk capital city at night, entered through monumental gates, old-town core of stone alleys
location.real_analog: Centro Historico, Mexico City at night (the treatment's Mexico City wandering footage): Zocalo approach, narrow colonial stone streets, lit windows; a valley city once built on a lake
near: Light Gates and the ancestors' field outside
the sea it rises from / the harbor

situation: Still night. The POET sees the entrance to Atlantis, goes in through the gates, and experiences the city as the verse describes: a welcoming crowd, nature folded into the city, candlelit narrow streets, glowing windows. When the voiceover ends he keeps wandering through Atlantis until he reaches a house that people are entering, and he goes inside.
weather_light: clear night; photo-realistic cyberpunk grade; flickering candlelight, warm-lit windows, shadows down narrow streets, sound-made rainbows and golden light on the risen city (spine)

set_pieces.name: The Light Gates open
set_pieces.what_happens: Marble gates with wings swing open to an ancestral orchestra; a line of figures, the POET among them, walks through into the radiant city.
lines: an orchestra of our ancestors wildest dreams
set_pieces.camera: low wide on the gates opening, POET entering frame from behind camera; reverse to the city glowing through
set_pieces.position: city boundary, the gate facing the field

set_pieces.name: Road down, following comets
set_pieces.what_happens: Past the gate the road descends into the luminous city under comets; generations of faces line the way.
lines: to follow comets to the capital city
set_pieces.camera: drone or crane following POET down the processional road, tilt up to comet streaks
set_pieces.position: processional road from the gate down toward the center

set_pieces.name: The city rises / here we are all one
set_pieces.what_happens: Atlantis rises from the depths in golden light; diverse beings gather and look up together.
set_pieces.camera: extreme wide establishing as the city lifts, cut to POET in the gathering, faces lit from above
set_pieces.position: edge of the city center plaza

set_pieces.name: Jungle Interface and the heart-scan admission
set_pieces.what_happens: Jungle merges into crystalline buildings over overgrown ruins; children and elders draw symbols in sand; a gate scans the POET's heart instead of a pass.
lines: the pact we've made here with nature
set_pieces.camera: handheld walk-through of vines on stone; insert of the heart-scan gate reading POET's chest
set_pieces.position: garden quarter between the gate road and the center

set_pieces.name: City Center: all safe
set_pieces.what_happens: Back at the center, now fully alive; a ring of protective light encircles the community; unknown architecture glows.
lines: But here we are all safe
set_pieces.camera: slow 360 orbit around POET in the plaza

set_pieces.name: Narrow streets by candlelight
set_pieces.what_happens: POET walks stone alleys barely two people wide; candle flame blooms, shadows stretch, families gather behind lit windows, children's laughter, clouds set free.
set_pieces.camera: Steadicam behind POET down the alley (never a face-on EX; none present), candle close-ups, window POVs

set_pieces.name: Could stay forever, then wandering to the house
set_pieces.what_happens: He sits a moment as Atlantis shines; voiceover ends ('welcoming me, & welcoming all'), he keeps wandering and arrives at a house where people are entering, and goes in.
set_pieces.camera: seated medium then wide; later documentary-style wandering (Mexico City footage) ending on a doorway with people filing in
set_pieces.position: residential street off the Narrow Streets, at the house door

arrival.from_previous: From the ancestors' parade in the still-night field he sees the entrance to Atlantis and goes in on foot.

departure.to_next: After the voiceover he wanders the city and finally arrives at a house people are entering; he enters (the DJ Turn Me Up house party).

encoding: Atlantis is the 'capital city of our collective consciousness', a fiction everyone agrees to live in; the map marks this zone as false heaven and techno-faith, so its warmth is real to him and also a stage. It has to be a walled city with a gate because Nevermore's reclaimed heart and Bloodline's inheritance are what get him in (the spine's heart-scan gate). The candlelit streets lead to the house where he will finally speak his love story aloud.

open_questions: The spine shows the city rising from the sea (AT025, AT059, AT060) and floating above clouds (AT022); the treatment shows Mexico City streets. Is the rising a one-time vision at entry, or is Atlantis a coastal city? Hot Minute's harbor and Magic Ride's surrounding mountains suggest a harbor city in a mountain ring.
AT015 'A descent into a luminous underworld': is the city below the field (a downhill approach) or underground?
Text variants: timings say 'The pack' and 'as a mission'; treatment says 'the pact' and 'as the admission'.
Which street or house in the Mexico City footage is 'the house'? Not identified.
Several AT ids repeat with different timestamps (AT009, AT025, AT029, AT059...), so one id may cover several frames.
